set.body:
Goal: no enum member should be a compilable value that a phase rejects at runtime. Geom.Rect and Stat.Count are declared, given requiredAesthetics, then blacklisted.

Evidence: Geom.Rect (Grammar.scala:145) with requiredAesthetics (Grammar.scala:152) is rejected in MappingPhase.planLayer (CompilerPhases.scala:40-43) and again in GeomPhase.lower (CompilerPhases.scala:219-220). Stat.Count (Grammar.scala:156) is rejected because any non-Identity stat is refused (CompilerPhases.scala:32-33). This violates the module invalid-states-unrepresentable creed.

Acceptance: after the geoms and typed-stats issues land, Geom.Rect lowers (Grob.Rect already exists at Scene.scala) and Stat.Count computes; then remove the runtime blacklists so the enum admits only implemented members. Closeout check: no UnsupportedGeom/UnsupportedStat path remains for a declared member (or the member is removed). JVM+JS tests. Depends on the geoms and typed-stats issues.
set.title: Graphics: reconcile declared-but-rejected enum members with the invalid-states creed
